profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Software developer and interface coordinator representing the State of Minnesota's Department of Public Safety.

I manage the incoming and outgoing data in the State's Driver and Vehicle systems by developing APIs and file processes, and coordinating between the internal teams and various external clients.

My focus is on building and optimizing clean, easy-to-maintain code, as well as ensuring satisfactory relationships between internal and external teams.

positions.title: Software Developer/Interface Coordinator
positions.description:
Minnesota Department of Public Safety
Recipient: Annual performance bonus 3 years in a row from 2018 (rewarded to a small percentage of employees).

Project Highlights:
- Successfully launched two high profile government projects to completely replace the state's existing Driver and Vehicle Services software. Worked in a team of 4 to replace 100+ interfaces across 30+ vendors. *See articles below.
- Designed and developed a credit card payment interface between the State and US Bank using REST APIs. Coordinated work/meetings between the front end and financial (internal) teams, and the client.
- Streamlined the state's manual examination registration process with IDEMIA using REST APIs to automate the process. Enhanced work efficiency by over 50%.
- Built and maintained SOAP web services to receive incoming calls from the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension - packaging and responding with driver and vehicle information. Traffic: over 200,000 calls per day.
- Created jobs to query for all driver and vehicle data in the state's system to create data extract files using a SQL server cursor. Over 6 million driver records and over 13 million vehicle records.
- Implemented several services to systematically process inbound/outbound files from/to various vendors, including delta files that track all changes to driver and vehicle records in the system.

positions.title: Software Developer/Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
- Translated business models into software processes.
- Communicated technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Experienced the full lifecycle of software development: defining requirements, developing the application, documentation and configuration, iterative SIT & UAT testing and debugging, presenting and training the end users, deploying solution, and maintaining the product.

Project Highlights:
- Implemented a case flow that tracks the status of taxpayers' Judgments processes using FAST's proprietary configuration methodology.
- Designed and launched the web form used for collecting/filing the Use Tax for the State of VT.

positions.title: Senior Sales Consultant
positions.description:
Skills learned:
Customer Service

Mobile Phone Troubleshooting
Training new employees

Highlight:
Coded an automated macro program to send texts to customers more efficiently, increasing its efficiency by over 1000%
